clue.text: Vacant blonde on the way will be attractive

indicators.note: a vacant word has its insides emptied out, leaving only its first and last letters

parts.note: something on the way is arriving or approaching

explanation.surface: A rather dim blonde on her way somewhere is going to look appealing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vacant' looks like an insult describing the blonde, but it says to empty the word, leaving BE.
explanation.definitionFit: A becoming outfit or manner is one that suits and flatters, a close synonym of attractive.

clue.text: Confer and trounce old women

parts.note: to best someone is to beat them soundly
W is the abbreviation for women, as on toilet doors

explanation.surface: A command to award honours and also to beat some elderly ladies.
explanation.definitionFit: To bestow is to grant or present an honour, the same sense as confer.

clue.text: Reasons may see politician abandoning universities

indicators.note: the politician abandoning the universities means those letters leave the longer word

parts.note: campuses stand for universities by metonymy
MP, Member of Parliament, is the crossword politician

explanation.surface: A politician quitting academia might give reasons for leaving.
explanation.walkthrough: Take MP out of CAMPUSES; 'may see' is just linking words.
explanation.definitionFit: Causes and reasons are synonyms: the grounds or motives behind something.

clue.text: Snake dance from Brazil with a different beginning

indicators.note: the Brazilian dance keeps all but its first letter, which is swapped for another

parts.note: the samba is the national dance of Brazil

explanation.surface: A snake dance originating in Brazil, but starting differently.
explanation.definitionFit: The mamba is a venomous African snake, the black mamba being the best known.

clue.text: Criticise choice under fool

indicators.note: in a down clue the choice is placed below the fool

parts.note: nit, short for nitwit, is a fool
your pick is your choice

explanation.surface: Someone is told to find fault with a decision made by an idiot.
explanation.definitionFit: To nitpick is to criticise petty details fussily.

clue.text: People who work in prison may be cheats

definitions.meaning: to screw someone is slang for cheating or swindling them

explanation.surface: A claim that prison staff may be swindlers.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are slang: prison officers, and the verb meaning swindles.

clue.text: Suppressive measure from buffoon imprisoning a politician (Democrat)

indicators.note: the buffoon locks the other letters up inside itself

parts.note: a buffoon is a clown
MP, Member of Parliament, is a politician
D is the abbreviation for a US Democrat

explanation.surface: A crackdown arising from a jester who has jailed a Democrat politician.
explanation.definitionFit: A clampdown is a severe official crackdown, a measure that suppresses activity.

clue.text: Pushing criminal, begin low

indicators.note: criminal suggests something bent or wrong, so the letters are twisted out of order

explanation.surface: A criminal starts pushing people, beginning with a low blow.
explanation.definitionFit: Elbowing means shoving one's way through, a kind of pushing.

clue.text: Reserve place for pier around the fourth of September

indicators.note: the seaside goes around the chosen letter

parts.note: piers are built at the seaside

indicators.note: the fourth of September is read as the fourth letter of that word

explanation.surface: Booking a seaside spot with a pier for the fourth of September.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The fourth of September' looks like a date but means the fourth letter, T. British seaside resorts often have pleasure piers.
explanation.definitionFit: To set aside is to keep something in reserve for later use.

clue.text: Person with whom to arrange meals out?

definitions.text: Person with whom to arrange meals out?

indicators.note: arranging puts the letters of the following words into a new order

explanation.surface: Asking who your ideal dinner date might be.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both anagram and definition: a partner is just the person you'd plan dinners out with.
explanation.definitionFit: A life partner or kindred spirit is the natural companion for planning romantic dinners.

clue.text: Willing to finish early and scrap tactical play

indicators.note: finishing early means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: game means willing, as in game for anything
a scrap is a small bit

explanation.surface: Someone keen to stop early and drop a strategic move.
explanation.definitionFit: A gambit is an opening move in chess, and by extension any calculated tactical ploy.

clue.text: Complaint from Belgium on raised charge

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: B is the international vehicle code for Belgium

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the word is read upwards

parts.note: a fee is a charge

explanation.surface: A grievance from Belgium about an increased fee.
explanation.definitionFit: A beef is informal slang for a grievance or complaint.

clue.text: Worker sees nothing for each musical rejected

parts.note: O, the figure zero, means nothing
per means for each, as in per person

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the musical is read backwards

parts.note: Evita is the Lloyd Webber musical

explanation.surface: A worker gets nothing per show after a musical is turned down.
explanation.definitionFit: An operative is a worker, especially a skilled machine operator or a secret agent.

clue.text: Hands should accept northern men on board

indicators.note: the hands accept, that is take in, the other letter

parts.note: paws is informal for hands

explanation.surface: Crew are told they ought to welcome men from the north on board ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hands' and 'men on board' suggest sailors; the board is a chessboard.
explanation.definitionFit: Pawns are the lowliest chessmen, the pieces lined up on the board.

clue.text: A flyer's fleece

definitions.meaning: a bird of the crow family, which flies
to fleece is to swindle someone out of money

explanation.surface: A pilot's sheepskin jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: The crow-like bird and the verb meaning swindle share this spelling.

clue.text: Put up some guides in a group as arranged

indicators.note: Put up says the hidden letters are read backwards
some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Accommodating a party of tour guides as planned.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'Put up' means read upwards, not give lodging.
explanation.definitionFit: Organised and arranged both describe things set out in order or planned in advance.

clue.text: Father had put on a serious face

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title
had in the sense of possessed, owned

explanation.surface: The priest had adopted a solemn expression.
explanation.definitionFit: To frown is to wrinkle the brow and look stern or serious.

clue.text: Detectives finding drug during leave worry

parts.note: DIs are Detective Inspectors

indicators.note: the drug comes during, that is inside, the word for leave

parts.note: to quit is to leave
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Police find drugs while on leave, and are worried.
explanation.definitionFit: Disquiet is a feeling of unease or anxiety, much like worry.

clue.text: One who examines classes so rigidly boxed

indicators.note: boxed means enclosed, so the letters sit inside the words

explanation.surface: An examiner who sorts classes so strictly into boxes.
explanation.definitionFit: An assessor evaluates or examines candidates, claims or property.

clue.text: Understanding boundaries of Italian tourist attraction

indicators.note: the boundaries of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: a sight is something tourists go to see

explanation.surface: Grasping the borders of an Italian landmark.
explanation.definitionFit: Insight is deep understanding of a person or situation.

clue.text: Beats view from the south

indicators.note: in a down clue, reading from the south means reading upwards

parts.note: to spot is to see or view

explanation.surface: Seeing the beats from a southern vantage point.
explanation.definitionFit: To top something is to beat or surpass it.

clue.text: Royal family gathering at last

parts.note: kin are family

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: The royal family finally gathers.
explanation.definitionFit: A king is a royal, the reigning male monarch.

clue.text: Expertise lacking for the audience in what way?

indicators.note: for the audience means the word is as heard, not as spelt

parts.note: no means lacking, as in no money
how means in what way

explanation.surface: Without skill, the audience asks how it's done.
explanation.definitionFit: Know-how is practical skill and expertise.

clue.text: I confess, supporting Republican revolution

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits underneath the other

parts.note: to sing is slang for confessing to the police

explanation.surface: An admission of backing a Republican uprising.
explanation.walkthrough: Order in the grid is R then ISING, since the confession is below, supporting R.
explanation.definitionFit: A rising is an uprising or rebellion, a revolution.

clue.text: End of break — almost time for a piece by 14

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

parts.note: nigh means almost, nearly

explanation.surface: It's nearly time to take a break, before writing something.
explanation.walkthrough: 14 is ROOK: on a chessboard this piece starts beside the rook.
explanation.definitionFit: The chess knight stands next to the rook at the start of a game.

clue.text: Mosque encouraged to welcome head of state

indicators.note: the words welcome, that is hold within them, the letters

explanation.surface: A mosque is urged to receive a visiting head of state.
explanation.definitionFit: A reigning queen is the head of state in a monarchy.

clue.text: Medicinal preparation covering most of Italy's capital gets publicity

indicators.note: the medicine covers, so wraps around, the other letters

parts.note: a potion is a medicinal drink

indicators.note: most of means all but the last letter

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy

explanation.surface: A drug that covers most of the Italian capital gets advertised.
explanation.definitionFit: Promotion is advertising or publicity for a product.

clue.text: Refuse, as not working on a line

parts.note: a machine that is off is not working

explanation.surface: Rubbish, since it isn't working on a production line.
explanation.definitionFit: Offal means entrails, and in older use waste matter or refuse.

clue.text: Maintain insurance is essentially pointless

indicators.note: the essence of a word is its central letter

explanation.surface: Someone claims that insurance is basically pointless.
explanation.definitionFit: To insist and to maintain both mean to assert firmly.

clue.text: Straining to accept husband moving

indicators.note: the straining word accepts the letter inside it

parts.note: straining through a sieve is sifting

explanation.surface: Struggling to accept that a husband is moving out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Straining' looks like effort, but it means passing through a sieve.
explanation.definitionFit: Shifting means moving or changing position.

clue.text: Long angry speech from one in business

indicators.note: one goes in the word for business

parts.note: trade is business or commerce
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A rant delivered by somebody in commerce.
explanation.definitionFit: A tirade is a lengthy, angry denunciation or harangue.

clue.text: Poor wit needs cheerful period of decline

indicators.note: poor signals the letters are in bad shape and must be reworked

parts.note: light means cheerful, as in light-hearted

explanation.surface: Weak humour needs a lighter touch as things go downhill.
explanation.definitionFit: Twilight is figuratively the final declining phase of something, as in twilight years.
